newsitem.title: USA: Cygne sees $31 mln from AnnTaylor deal.
newsitem.headline: Cygne sees $31 mln from AnnTaylor deal.

text.p: Cygne Designs Inc said Monday it expected a pre-tax gain of about $31 million from the sale of a division and an interest in a joint venture to AnnTaylor Stores Corp.

In a separate statement, AnnTaylor said it had completed the deal to buy Cygne's 60-percent interest in a joint venture with it called CAT, as well as a division known as Ann Taylor Woven Division that sourced AnnTaylor merchandising.
It said it had paid Cygne 2,348,145 common shares and about $9.7 million in cash for fixed assets, inventory and settlement of open accounts payable by AnnTaylor to Cygne.
It said it would also assume certain liabilities related to the operation of the division.
